<p dir="auto">A toolbox for  visualizations of EEG/ERP data and Unfold.jl models.
Based on the <a href="https://github.com/unfoldtoolbox/unfold.jl/">Unfold</a> and <a href="https://makie.juliaplots.org/stable/" rel="nofollow">Makie</a>, it grants users high performance, and highly customizable plots.</p>
<p dir="auto">We currently support:
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unfoldtoolbox/UnfoldMakie.jl/8plots3/docs/src/assets/complex_plot.png"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unfoldtoolbox/UnfoldMakie.jl/8plots3/docs/src/assets/complex_plot.png" width="300" align="right" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>

<p dir="auto">The recommended way to install julia is <a href="https://github.com/JuliaLang/juliaup">juliaup</a>.
It allows you to, e.g., easily update Julia at a later point, but also to test out alpha/beta versions etc.</p>
<p dir="auto">TLDR: If you don't want to read the explicit instructions, just copy the following command</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Windows</h4><a id="user-content-windows" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Windows" href="#windows"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Quickstart</h2><a id="user-content-quickstart" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Quickstart" href="#quickstart"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using UnfoldMakie
using CairoMakie # backend
using Unfold, UnfoldSim # Fit / Simulation

data, evts = UnfoldSim.predef_eeg(; noiselevel = 12, return_epoched = true)
data = reshape(data, 1, size(data)...) # simulate a single channel

times = range(0, step = 1 / 100, length = size(data, 2))
m = fit(UnfoldModel, @formula(0 ~ 1 + condition), evts, data, times)

plot_erp(coeftable(m))"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> UnfoldMakie
<span class="pl-k">using</span> CairoMakie <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> backend</span>
<span class="pl-k">using</span> Unfold, UnfoldSim <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Fit / Simulation</span>

data, evts <span class="pl-k">=</span> UnfoldSim<span class="pl-k">.</span><span class="pl-c1">predef_eeg</span>(; noiselevel <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">12</span>, return_epoched <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">true</span>)
data <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">reshape</span>(data, <span class="pl-c1">1</span>, <span class="pl-c1">size</span>(data)<span class="pl-k">...</span>) <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> simulate a single channel</span>

times <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">range</span>(<span class="pl-c1">0</span>, step <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">1</span> <span class="pl-k">/</span> <span class="pl-c1">100</span>, length <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">size</span>(data, <span class="pl-c1">2</span>))
m <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">fit</span>(UnfoldModel, <span class="pl-c1">@formula</span>(<span class="pl-c1">0</span> <span class="pl-k">~</span> <span class="pl-c1">1</span> <span class="pl-k">+</span> condition), evts, data, times)

<span class="pl-c1">plot_erp</span>(<span class="pl-c1">coeftable</span>(m))</pre></div>

<ol dir="auto">
<li>We recommend to write a Literate.jl document and place it in <code>docs/literate/FOLDER/FILENAME.jl</code> with <code>FOLDER</code> being <code>HowTo</code>, <code>Explanation</code>, <code>Tutorial</code> or <code>Reference</code> (<a href="https://documentation.divio.com/" rel="nofollow">recommended reading on the 4 categories</a>).</li>
<li>Literate.jl converts the <code>.jl</code> file to a <code>.md</code> automatically and places it in <code>docs/src/generated/FOLDER/FILENAME.md</code>.</li>
<li>Edit <a href="https://github.com/unfoldtoolbox/Unfold.jl/blob/main/docs/make.jl">make.jl</a> with a reference to <code>docs/src/generated/FOLDER/FILENAME.md</code>.</li>
</ol>
